Candidate_A_Analytical_Baseline.description: Zero-learned parameter baseline (pure V8.1 analytical estimator)

Candidate_B_MLP_Residual.layers: Linear(136, 64) -> LayerNorm -> SiLU -> Linear(64, 64) -> SiLU -> Linear(64, 66)
Candidate_B_MLP_Residual.weaknesses: Cannot model temporal momentum or direction reversals

Candidate_C_TCN_Residual.layers: 3x Dilated Conv1d (d_in=136, d_hidden=48, kernel=3, dilations=[1, 2, 4]) + Residual Head
Candidate_C_TCN_Residual.strengths: Fixed finite receptive field, fully parallel inference
Candidate_C_TCN_Residual.weaknesses: Requires 16-frame buffer; fixed dilation limits adaptive gap scaling

Candidate_D_GRU_Residual.strengths: Standard recurrence, compact hidden state (96 floats)
Candidate_D_GRU_Residual.weaknesses: Prone to exploding/vanishing hidden state over gaps > 24 frames

Candidate_E_Mamba_SSM_Residual.layers: InputProj(136, 64) -> BiDirectional/Causal Mamba Block (d_model=64, d_state=16) -> Linear(64, 66)
Candidate_E_Mamba_SSM_Residual.strengths: Linear-time sequence scaling, input-dependent selective filtering, continuous-time discretization adapts to variable gaps
Candidate_E_Mamba_SSM_Residual.weaknesses: Requires specialized scan implementation on microcontroller hardware

Candidate_F_Hybrid_Conv_Mamba.strengths: Combines local high-frequency acceleration capture with long-horizon selective SSM memory
Candidate_F_Hybrid_Conv_Mamba.weaknesses: Slightly higher compute than pure Mamba
